rationale: Keep the exact bit-preserving scalar copy and the baseline linear 256-thread dispatch. The measured workload is dominated by small and medium grids where launch overhead and strided access dominate; no supplied counters establish a memory or occupancy bottleneck, and vectorization is unsafe because offsets and strides are only 4-byte aligned and may be odd. Retaining the baseline avoids correctness risk and preserves all output padding.
